1.t: By those who drag forth to destruction,

5.t: And those who govern the event,

6.t: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.

8.t: On that day hearts beat painfully

10.t: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state

11.t: Even after we are crumbled bones?

12.t: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.

13.t: Surely it will need but one shout,

14.t: And lo! they will be awakened.

15.t: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?

16.t: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,

17.t: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -

18.t: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?

19.t: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).

20.t: And he showed him the tremendous token.

22.t: Then turned he away in haste,

24.t: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."

25.t: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.

26.t: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.

27.t: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?

28.t: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;

29.t: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.

30.t: And after that He spread the earth,

31.t: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,

32.t: And He made fast the hills,

33.t: A provision for you and for your cattle.

34.t: But when the great disaster cometh,

35.t: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,

36.t: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,

37.t: Then, as for him who rebelled

38.t: And chose the life of the world,

39.t: Lo! hell will be his home.

40.t: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,

41.t: Lo! the Garden will be his home.

42.t: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?

43.t: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?

44.t: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.

45.t: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.

46.t: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
